section: Song of the Elves skill requirements

steps.title: 70 Farming
steps.note: Do tree runs 1-2x/day: plant the best tree/fruit-tree/hardwood saplings you can, check for XP, replant - by far the fastest effective XP.

steps.title: 70 Herblore
steps.note: Make Super restore (63) -> Ranging (72) -> Saradomin brew (81) -> Super combat (90); amulet of chemistry / goggles cut the cost.

steps.title: 70 Construction
steps.note: Build mahogany tables then gnome benches in the Dining room with a demon butler - fastest XP but expensive (teak/oak to save gp).

steps.title: 70 Hunter
steps.note: Bird house trapping on Fossil Island (needs Bone Voyage) - passive runs every 50 min, fastest XP to ~80; drift net at 44 if training Fishing.

steps.title: 70 Mining
steps.note: 3-tick mine granite (3t4g) at Bandit Camp Quarry / Cape Conch for fastest XP; no-tick: iron to 70 then Volcanic Mine. AFK: Motherlode Mine.

steps.title: 70 Woodcutting
steps.note: Chop teak trees - 1.5-tick teaks on Fossil Island is the fastest in game. AFK/no-tick: teaks to 65 then sulliuscep mushrooms.

steps.title: 70 Smithing
steps.note: Smelt gold bars at the Blast Furnace with goldsmith gauntlets (fastest viable); Giants' Foundry is a good XP + profit alternative.
